name: Should I DIY room addition drywall or hire a professional?
description: DIY is possible for small projects, but room additions are usually better handled by a professional if you want a smooth, paint-ready result.

mainEntity.name: Should I DIY room addition drywall or hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you want the work done cleanly and on the same schedule as the rest of the addition, hire a pro when you need straight walls, consistent seams, and a paint-ready finish. DIY can work for small areas, but room additions usually involve too much finishing detail for most homeowners.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY is possible for small projects, but room additions are usually better handled by a professional if you want a smooth, paint-ready result.
